string.value: Somewhere in this desert, out task force team went for recon mission and disappeared.
I don't believe they all died - they were trained professionals, not some National Guard weekend soldiers.
If you're lucky to find them, inform the home base immediately.
Deserthole is a small mining town.
After the mine was closed, its citizens lost their jobs, and since then their main occupation is brewing, selling and taking some cactus moonshine.
Anyway, our country won't leave its people in trouble, so the evacuation of Deserthole is one of your duties!
You must rid the honorable Deserthole citizens of marauders.
Half job done, all those who survived will be evacuated shortly. Go on with your mission.
Such outrageous neglect of safety measures!
The abandoned chemical reactor of the secret lab emits poisonous fumes without control.
If we destroy the lab physically, it will result in even more pollution of the environment, but if we destroy the local power station, it will be a perfect solution of the problem.
It's too late! It seems the waste collectors had failed, and the lab exploded. The cloud of poisonous gas covered the entire area. I guess no-one survived.
The reports of instant mutations, caused by substance Z-120, turned out to be true.
Whoever these people were in past, they're not human now! Destroy them immediately in the name of democracy and safety of people of our country.
All right, your work here is done. It's time to continue your primary mission.
Start working on your primary objective. You need to find professor Pappers and evacuate him from the base at any cost.
Professor rescue mission has the highest priority. Remember this!
I'm afraid we're late again.
This doesn't look to me like an accident. It looks like a well-planned sabotage. It seems, the base is destroyed completely, and the source of Z-120 leak is right here.
We need to find out how many people survived and what happened to Pappers. Search the ruins.
These eggheads ignored all the instructions. Instead of waiting for evacuation, they just scattered everywhere!
Now it's nearly impossible to determine the exact number of survivors. The task number one is find what happened to professor Pappers.
Return to the base immediately.
